gates.name: at rest (< 2 px/f), % of frames
gates.target: >= 30 (Rick median 32, range 6-58)

gates.name: rests per 10 s
gates.target: 2.2-4.5, aim 3 (Rick 3.1, range 0.9-4.7; the plan reads about 1 higher than the picture). CB 2026-11-10: the scene decides, but the camera must flow like his

gates.name: rest length median, s
gates.target: >= 0.6 (Rick 0.62); one in ten >= 1.8
gates.fix: raise hold on short stations, or drop a station

gates.name: longest travel, s
gates.target: 3-7 in a film of 30 s or more: at least one long flowing move (Rick's long travels: median 3.0, upper quarter 4.8-9.5; Railroads and Roller Coasters 4.7)

gates.name: speed median px/f
gates.target: about 4 (Rick 4.1, middle half 2.5-6.1)
gates.fix: too calm: raise the creep on the rests, add a drift, or lengthen the travels

gates.name: speed p90 px/f
gates.target: about 23 (Rick 23, range 9.8-33.8)
gates.fix: the travels crawl: cover more distance or take fewer frames (set travel on the station)

gates.name: dead still (reads under 0.3 px/f when measured), % of frames
gates.target: <= 21, aim 9 (Rick 9.3, range 1-29)
gates.fix: the rests are parked: raise creep on those stations or add a drift

gates.name: speed peak px/f
gates.target: <= 60 outside planned whips

gates.name: cuts per 10 s
gates.target: <= 0.9, aim 0.4 (Rick 0.4; CB: fewer cuts)
gates.fix: merge takes: travel between framings inside one take, cut only on a place or time jump

gates.name: tilt while resting, deg
gates.target: level (<= 0.5); tilt only inside a move (Rick: 0 % of holds)

gates.name: lens outside 16-55 mm on non-insert frames, %
gates.target: wide and close: about 24 mm = 73 deg tall (Rick, measured); long lenses only for object inserts

gates.name: travels that swing the view over 120 deg
gates.target: 0: lay the places along the travel direction so the camera never turns back

gates.name: camera v2 notes (flowed-through stations, short travels, capped whips)
word stations not at rest on their word
gates.target: 0: key nouns land with the camera at rest, 0-6 f before the word (CB's rule)

gates.name: first face, s
gates.target: <= 1.5 (Rick median 0.0)

gates.name: longest stretch without a face, s
frames with a face, %
gates.target: 45-68 (Rick 55, range 23-66): about a third of the film belongs to the world and the story object

gates.name: head width / frame width, median
gates.target: about 0.25 (Rick 0.25, range 0.16-0.52)
gates.fix: figures are too small: move the camera closer (a whole-body rest sits about 2.4 m from a standing adult at 24 mm)

gates.name: head centre height, median (0 = top)
gates.target: 0.45 (Rick 0.39-0.51), above the caption band
gates.fix: raise or lower the aim point so faces sit just above centre

gates.name: head centres inside the caption band, % of all heads on screen
face frames with the head cut by the edge, %
face frames where the whole body fits, %
at rest while a face is on screen, %
gates.target: >= 40 (Rick 41): rest on faces, move on places and objects

gates.name: shot mix W/M/C/P/O, % of time
gates.target: whole body 45, medium 20, close <= 7, place 15, object insert <= 15 (Rick)
gates.fix: object inserts and close-ups are the two that run over

gates.name: world-led frames (place + object framing), % of time
gates.target: 25-40 (Rick: place 15 + object up to 15; his 3D films are about half world-led by eye)

gates.name: medium shots, % of time
gates.target: about 20 (Rick): the middle size is the dull one

gates.name: places in the film
gates.target: >= 4, aim 5-8 at 55 s or more (Rick's 3D films: 5-8 places)

gates.name: share of the film in its most used light, %
gates.target: <= 75: 2-3 kinds of light per film (day, golden, morning, night, interior); the light changes at the turn of the story

gates.name: same framing on the same subject in a row (stations)
gates.fix: change the shot size, or put someone else in the picture

gates.name: sentences table
gates.target: film.json needs 'sentences' so the story gates can run
gates.fix: add one row per sentence: words [first, last], subject, nouns

gates.name: pose or face changes per 10 s on screen
gates.target: >= 4 (Rick 4.5 on one figure, range 3-7; this counts every figure on screen)

gates.name: longest fully frozen figure with a resting camera, s
gates.target: <= 3 unless something else moves

gates.name: held props without a hand
gates.target: 0: every held prop is attached to a hand on every frame

gates.name: camera goes around a figure but its view never changes
gates.target: 0: a pure camera move never turns a character; the view follows the camera (act key look / look_full)
gates.fix: scepticDriver f1-10: camera goes 64 deg around, view stays side (no look); scepticDriver f11-20: camera goes 50 deg around, view stays 34 (no look); rookieDriver f31-40: camera goes 64 deg around, view stays side (no look); rookieDriver f41-50: camera goes 50 deg around, view stays 34 (no look); milkmanDriver f61-70: camera goes 64 deg around, view stays side (no look); milkmanDriver f71-80: camera goes 50 deg around, view stays 34 (no look). Give the act a look (target, world point or cam) and look_full for the true angle

gates.name: effects per 10 s
gates.target: 1-2, on the action noun or verb (Rick)
gates.fix: add a glint, glow, stamp, coin or dust hit on the key nouns

gates.name: mood (light / colour) changes per minute
gates.target: >= 12, in-shot on the word (Rick 13.7, range 3.9-15.5)
gates.fix: add light or colour shifts on the turn, the proof and the payoff
